source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

title: An Application and Interview
instructions: Write your own first draft using your own details. Do not copy the speaking example.
prompt: Write 120–160 words about a fictional job application and interview. Explain why you applied, give one past experience and skill, describe a question about duties or pay, and explain what happened afterwards. Use at least six different lesson words, past simple, a did question or negative, and because or so.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Write four parts: the vacancy and application; your past example; the interview question and response; the result or next step. Use your own details. Here resume means “begin again,” not a job document.
